title: Rook technique
intro: Rooks love open files and the back rank. Learn when to trade them and how to use them against a weak back rank.

lessons.title: Trade rooks into a pawn ending
lessons.summary: When your king is better placed, the trade wins.

steps.text: Black's d-pawn is passed and supported by the rook. But White can take it: Rxd3 offers a rook trade with check, and then White's king is right in front of the action.
Take the pawn and trade rooks.
steps.hint: Capture on d3 with the rook, with check.
steps.ifRight: The rooks are off and White's extra kingside pawn wins the king and pawn ending.

steps.text: The rooks face each other on the b-file. After Rxb8 Rxb8 Rxb8, White's last rook lands on the back rank with check and Black is a rook down.
Win the rook on the b-file.
steps.hint: Capture on b8. Two rooks attack it, only one defends.
steps.ifRight: Two attackers beat one defender: White is a rook up.

steps.text: Mate the king on the back rank.
steps.hint: Your king takes away the squares on the 7th rank.
steps.ifRight: Checkmate: the king covered a7, b7 and c7.
